description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kawuduluwewa, 1st step Medirigiriya, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership, property rights, and cadastral matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
